fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local commentary on Miami’s switch from one-way to two-way downtown streets and anticipated traffic accidents; employment conditions affecting working women; low teacher pay in Dade County; Governor John W. Martin’s criticism of Dade County and threats regarding betting; concerns about American flag etiquette at a Flagler Street barbecue stand; police efforts to remove con artists and other “undesirables”; discussion of whether to spend $50,000 on northern publicity given reports that president-elect Herbert Hoover will visit Miami; promotion and satire around greyhound/dog racing (Miami Beach Kennel Club and a humorous “Souse Beach Handicap”); notes on labor conflict involving the Capitol theatre; letters and material on Florida Power & Light franchise disputes (including Fort Myers); and local items on Coral Gables’ Coliseum leasing controversy and upcoming University of Miami football.
